København.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive place, half price for other places (dagtilbud, fritidsinstitution/KKFO/fritidshjem); no sibling subsidy for klub or private fritidsinstitution.
København.note: The same price applies to fritidsinstitution and KKFO. July is free. The page lists no separate morning price and no grade-specific price.

Frederiksberg.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive place, half price for the others (applies to dagtilbud, private pasning with subsidy and SFO 1; not to klubber or private school schemes).
Frederiksberg.note: SFO 1 rate; the SFO rate is the same in the 1 Jan 2026 and 1 May 2026 takst PDFs. Payment is collected monthly in advance. Neither the page nor the PDFs say whether July is free, so months is null.

Gentofte.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive place, 50% sibling subsidy on the other places; granted up to and including 5. klasse.
Gentofte.note: The SFO is called GFO in Gentofte (2025: 2,170 kr.). July is free. The page lists no separate morning price.

Gladsaxe.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive place, 50% off the other places (dagtilbud, SFO and skoleklub); none for private school schemes.
Gladsaxe.note: 2,103 kr. for SFO 0.-3. klasse, including 0. klasse (rate period 1 Jan-31 Dec 2026). The pages found do not say whether July is free. Sibling rule from gladsaxe.dk/.../friplads-og-tilskud.

Lyngby-Taarbæk.siblingDiscount: 50% of the parent payment on the place(s) where the municipal subsidy is lowest; covers dagtilbud, SFO and fritids-/ungdomsklub.
Lyngby-Taarbæk.note: Rate from 1 April 2026 for SFO børnehaveklasse-3. klasse. July is free for residents using a place in LTK. No separate morning price listed.

Hvidovre.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive place, half price for the other places (vuggestue, børnehave, kombineret institution, SFO1); none for klub/SFO2/SFO3 or private school SFO.
Hvidovre.note: SFO1 (0.-3. klasse). Explicitly billed in all 12 months; only SFO3 has July free. No separate morning price listed.

Rødovre.siblingDiscount: Sibling subsidy per dagtilbudsloven §43 (most expensive place at 100%, further places at 50%); for SFO it applies up to and including 6. klasse; none for private SFO.
Rødovre.note: SFO I (0.-3. klasse). July is free. Morning opening is included in SFO I; no separate morning price. The 100%/50% split is from the rk.dk dagtilbud takst page; the SFO page only confirms that a sibling subsidy exists.

Tårnby.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive place, half price for other places; does not apply to klubber.
Tårnby.note: Rate from 1 April 2026 (after the 2026 lowering of the parent share). The page does not say whether July is free. Caveat: dragoer.dk's cross-border table lists 1,852 kr. for Tårnby SFO, which seems to reflect Dragør's own rate.

Dragør.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive place, 50% of the payment for other places (dagtilbud or SFO); none for private SFO or klub.
Dragør.note: 'Taksterne opkræves over 12 måneder'; payment also due during holidays. Morning opening from 06:30 at some SFOs, no separate price. Also on dragoer.dk/boern-og-unge/dagtilbud-0-6-aar/takster-for-boernepasning.

Herlev.siblingDiscount: Full rate for the most expensive place, 50% discount for sibling places.
Herlev.note: LOWER CONFIDENCE: herlev.dk blocks automated fetch (Cloudflare 403). Values come from search-engine excerpts of this herlev.dk page: SFO 2,253 kr./month; rates billed monthly, with July free for SFO and klub. Needs a manual check.

Brøndby.siblingDiscount: Not stated on the SFO page (only fripladstilskud is described)
Brøndby.note: The page says 'Takster for 2025 og 2026 pr. måned SFO: 1.929 kr. (0.-3. klasse)' and 'Der skal ikke betales for juli'. Every SFO opens in the morning from 6:30 to 8:00, and no separate morning price is given. A linked PDF 'pr. 1. september 2025' shows 1.854 kr. for 2025, which doesn't match the page.

Glostrup.siblingDiscount: 50% of the parent payment, given on the cheapest places (siblings in dagtilbud, SFO or klub)
Glostrup.note: The SFO page says 'skolefritidsklub er 1.857 kr. om måneden i 2026', which looks like a wording slip. SFO covers 0.-3. klasse, and 3. klasse leaves on 31 March. Whether July is free was not found.

Ballerup.siblingDiscount: 50% discount on the oldest children (dagpleje, daginstitution, private care). Doesn't apply to byggelegeplads/klub or ungdomsklub. The page doesn't say explicitly whether BFO is covered.
Ballerup.note: SFO is called BFO (Ballerup FritidsOrdning), ages 6-9. The price is 1.898 kr. both from 1 Jan and from 1 Apr 2026, and was 1.745 kr. in 2025 (takst PDF). Whether July is free was not found.

Albertslund.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive place, half price for the others
Albertslund.note: SFO1 costs 2.013 kr. in 2026 (1.952 kr. in 2025). The page says 'alle takster afregnes alle 12 måneder'. No split by grade.

Rudersdal.siblingDiscount: Most expensive rate + 50% of the following rates
Rudersdal.note: SFO covers 0.-3. klasse, 2.290 kr. from 1 Jan 2026 (2.215 kr. in 2025). July is free for residents who use SFO in Rudersdal.

Furesø.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive child, 50% of the rate for each following child
Furesø.note: SFO is called FFO. FFO 1 (0.-3. klasse) costs 2.207 kr. in 2026 (2.141 kr. in 2025). Whether July is free was not found.

Vallensbæk.siblingDiscount: Full rate for the most expensive place, half price for the others (siblings must share an address; not for junior/ungdomsklub)
Vallensbæk.note: SFO covers 0.-4. klasse, 1961 kr. per month in the 2026 table. The 2026 cut applied only to daycare, and SFO has no 'ny takst'. Whether July is free was not found.

Ishøj.note: Low confidence: ishoj.dk is behind a Cloudflare challenge (403), so the page couldn't be read directly. The figures come from a search-engine summary of this official page: SFO1 (0.-3. klasse) 1.561 kr./month, SFO2 660 kr., July free. Rates are listed before sibling discount and friplads.

Høje-Taastrup.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive place, 50% for the following places (SFO included; klub and private-school SFO excluded)
Høje-Taastrup.note: SFO costs 1.917 kr. in 2026 (1.860 kr. in 2025), and 'juli er betalingsfri måned'. The pre-school SFO for April-June (before 0. klasse starts) costs 2.261 kr. The sibling rule is from htk.dk/borger/dagtilbud-og-skole/dagtilbud/tilskud-til-pasning-af-boern.

Hørsholm.siblingDiscount: Full price for the most expensive place, half price for the other places
Hørsholm.note: The price covers Børnehaveklasse-3. klasse; 4.-6. klasse costs 1.215 kr. July is free, except for places across the municipal border, which are billed for 12 months.
